limitations.summary: SolidJS 2, its web runtime, and the TanStack Solid 2 adapter are prerelease lines and must be advanced together through this canary.
TanStack Solid Start 2.0.0-rc.0 reported unclaimed hydration nodes for head().scripts; this canary avoids that API and treats every hydration warning as a failure.
TypeScript 7.0.2 is the native project compiler and does not expose the legacy JavaScript programmatic compiler API. No TypeScript 6 alias is currently used.
The authoring environment had no cached Solid/TanStack/Cloudflare packages and denied registry access, so install, framework build, and workerd preview remain unverified.
